title: Bruno Gadiol and the Estrelas da Casa Finale
seoTitle: Bruno Gadiol & Estrelas da Casa Finale: Pop vs. Pagode
subtitle: All about the singer's participation in the Pop vs. Pagode showdown
excerpt: Bruno Gadiol reaches the Estrelas da Casa finale after winning the semifinal with the mixed Pop group. Learn how voting works and what to expect from his performance.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Thursday (24), TV Globo broadcasts the grand finale of the music reality show Estrelas da Casa, with the mixed Pop and Pagode groups competing for the title of the third season. Singer Bruno Gadiol is part of the mixed Pop group that advanced in the semifinal.

The Estrelas da Casa Finale and Bruno Gadiol's Participation

The live show begins right after the soap opera Quem Ama Cuida, at 10:55 PM. In the Pop group, Bruno Gadiol performs alongside Leonna, Paula Tavares, and Yudchi. In the Pagode group, the mixed team consists of David Natel, Hanaya, Vick Nunes, and Uel.

How Public Voting Works

The winner is decided exclusively by public vote. The audience can vote via the official Gshow website; other polls, such as those by Tracklist and NSC Total, serve only as a thermometer and do not influence the final result.

Semifinal Results Leading to the Showdown

In the semifinal held on Tuesday (22), the mixed Pop group secured their spot with 53.93% of the votes, performing Queen's classic "Don't Stop Me Now." The mixed Pagode group advanced with 61.52% of the votes, singing "Trovão," a hit by Dilsinho.

What to Expect from Bruno Gadiol's Performance in the Finale

Bruno Gadiol and his group members have already shown their strength by performing "Don't Stop Me Now." In the finale, the expectation is that the group will maintain the energy of the semifinal, aiming to win the majority of the public's votes.

Impact on TV Globo's Programming

The finale concludes the 2026 season of Estrelas da Casa, following the program's reformulation that divides competitors between Pop and Pagode genres. The result will be announced live, concluding the dispute between the two mixed groups.

With information from Gshow, Tracklist, NSC Total.
